# GapCertificate — the Lacampagne-Selfridge counterexample

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proof drafted, not yet built

For the wheels up to 13 (cycle 30030), the gaps between consecutive survivors take every even value up to the largest gap, 22, except 20. This refutes de Polignac's 1849 guess (every even gap up to twice the second-largest wheel occurs) and Erdős's first guess for this cycle (every even value up to the largest gap occurs; Erdős Problem 854). Erdős asked for large enough cycles, so that eventual form stays open. Every survivor gap is even.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [M. Ziller, On differences between consecutive numbers coprime to primorials, arXiv:2007.01808 (2020)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.01808) — records de Polignac's guess and tabulates the missing gaps (Table 1); this node proves the wheels-up-to-13 row
- [T. F. Bloom, Erdős Problem 854](https://www.erdosproblems.com/854) — Erdős's guess and the Lacampagne-Selfridge computation at 2·3·5·7·11·13
- [DeepMind formal-conjectures, Erdős Problem 854](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/blob/main/FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/854.lean) — states the problem

## Claims

<a id="survivor_gaps_even"></a>
### `survivor_gaps_even`

Once the wheel 2 is in, every gap between consecutive survivors is even.

```lean
/-- **Every survivor gap is even** once the wheel 2 is in (bound at least 3). -/
def survivor_gaps_even : Prop :=
  ∀ limit g : Nat, 3 ≤ limit → survivor_gap limit g → 2 ∣ g
```

### `survivor_gaps_30030_present`

For the wheels up to 13, every other even gap up to 22 occurs, each with an explicit starting survivor.

```lean
def survivor_gaps_30030_present : Prop :=
  ∀ g ∈ ({2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 22} : Finset Nat), survivor_gap 14 g
```

### `de_polignac_gap_guess_false`

```lean

and 13. -/
def de_polignac_gap_guess_false : Prop :=
  ¬ de_polignac_gap_guess
```

<a id="erdos_first_guess_fails_at_13"></a>
### `erdos_first_guess_fails_at_13`

For the wheels up to 13 the gap 22 occurs but the smaller even number 20 does not.

```lean
/-- **Erdős's first guess fails for the wheels up to 13**: the gap 22 occurs,
the smaller even number 20 does not. -/
def erdos_first_guess_fails_at_13 : Prop :=
  survivor_gap 14 22 ∧ ¬ survivor_gap 14 20
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)
